run:
# comment line
set -g @a 1
%hidden X=hello
%if "#{==:#{@a},1}"
set -g @b "yes-#{X}"
%elif "1"
set -g @b elif
%else
set -g @b no
%endif
bind -n F7 set -g @k f7
bind -N "my note" -T mytab x display-message "hi"
bind -r -T mytab y send-keys -X cancel
unbind -n F5
set-hook -g after-select-pane 'set -g @hook fired'
set-hook -ga after-select-pane 'set -ga @hook +'
run-shell 'echo ran-from-run'
if-shell 'true' 'set -g @c ifyes' 'set -g @c ifno'
if-shell -F '0' 'set -g @d yes' 'set -g @d no'
set -g @e "5 6 7"
set -ag @e " 8"
set -g terminal-features[3] 'xterm*:RGB'
set -g status-left '[#S] '
bind -n F9 { display-message "braced" ; set -g @br 1 }
bind -T mytab z run-shell 'true' ; bind -n F6 switch-client -T mytab
set -g @multi 'one \
two'
